visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a tan shirt stands in a modern home interior next to a dark grey cabinet filled with figurines. He gestures energetically towards the room with both hands, smiling. (2) The camera pans to a living room sofa where three women, a small child, and a golden dog wearing a medical cone are sitting. One woman wears a white top, another a beige sweater. (3) The three women on the sofa stand up simultaneously and point directly at the camera with determined expressions. (4) The man in the tan shirt looks confused, placing a finger on his chin while question mark graphics appear around his head. (5) He holds up a cardboard box carrier containing three spray bottles of cleaning product, presenting it to the camera with a wide smile. (6) A close-up shows the cardboard carrier being held by a young child, then the man in a beige apron demonstrating the bottles in his kitchen. (7) A sequence of cleaning demonstrations follows: scrubbing a chrome faucet in a bathroom, wiping the inside of a microwave, and cleaning red liquid stains off a kitchen countertop with a blue cloth. (8) A woman with long hair appears in the mirror looking delighted and surprised at the shiny faucet, while another woman in the kitchen praises the man's cleaning results. (9) The man mops a light-colored wooden floor in the living room using a white flat mop, after spraying a clear bottle labeled 'Goodies & co.'. (10) The man stands proudly with his mop until a woman enters and pats him on the shoulder, and his face suddenly transforms into a distorted, comical filter showing an enlarged mouth and sweating animation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, medium-tempo electronic pop BGM featuring bright synth pads and a steady kick drum. A male voice speaks with high energy and a professional narrative tone, punctuated by a comical 'ding' sound effect. (2) As the scene shifts to the sofa, a brief 'whoosh' sound effect plays. A group of female voices shouts in high-arousal unison with a rising intonation pattern. (3) A digital meme sound effect (question mark sound) triggers as the man responds in a lower, confused pitch. The BGM remains constant in the background. (4) The narrator transitions to a promotional style, with high articulation clarity. Rhythmic 'psst-psst' liquid spray SFX are layered over the speech during the product reveal. (5) During the cleaning montage, metallic scrubbing noises and the sound of running water are clearly audible, accompanied by high-pitched female laughter and exclamations. (6) A friction sound of a mop on wood appears during the floor cleaning phase. The BGM swells slightly in volume during the conclusion. (7) The final phase features a teasing female voice and a comical 'boing' distortion sound effect that syncs with the man's exaggerated facial expression.
